title: Spinach Salad c Sour Cream Dressing
directions: In blender combine mayo, sour cream, onion, parsley, vinegar, lemon juice & garlic.
Toss spinach & mushrooms c dressing & serve.
notes: Written on a folded sheet of lined notepaper
raw_text:
Spinach Salad c Sour
Cream Dressing
1/2 c. mayo
1/2 c. sour cream
2 tbsp. gr. onion
2 tbsp. parsley
1 tbsp. vinegar
2 tbsp. lemon juice
1-2 garlic cloves crushed
1 c. mushrooms

In blender combine mayo, sour
cream, onion, parsley, vinegar, lemon
juice & garlic. Toss spinach &
mushrooms c dressing & serve.

raw_text:
Ruth.
Triple Orange Ambrosial Salad.
2 c. boiling liquid (fruit syrup or water)
1 - 6 oz pkg. orange flavored gelatin.
1 pint orange sherbet.
2 cans. (11 oz ea.) mandarin orange segments
drained.
1 can (13 1/2 oz) pineapple chunks drained.
1 cup flaked coconut
1 " miniature marshmallows (white) over

title: Triple Orange Ambrosial Salad
ingredients: 1 cup dairy sour cream, or 1/2 c whipping cream whipped (or dream whip)
directions: Pour boiling liquid over gelatin; stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add orange sherbet - stir until melted - stir in 1 can of orange seg. Pour into 6 cup ring mold. Chill till firm.
Combine rem. orange seg. - pineapple, coconut, marsh. Fold in sour cream. Chill 3 hrs. - fill centre of unmolded ring with fruit mixture.

title: Lemon Sauce
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch, salt. Add boiling water slowly, stirring constantly. Boil for 5 min.
Take from heat, add butter, lemon juice & beaten egg yolk.
raw_text:
Lemon Sauce.
1/2 c sugar.        2 tbsp. butter
1 tbsp. cornstarch  2 " lemon juice
1/8 tsp. salt.      1 egg yolk.
1 c boiling water
Mix sugar, cornstarch, salt. Add boiling water
slowly, stirring constantly. Boil for 5 min. Take
from heat, add butter, lemon juice & beaten egg yolk.

title: Blueberry Sauce
directions: In sm. pan bring sugar & juice to boil, stirring to dissolve the sugar.
Blend cornstarch c 2 tbsp water. Stir into pan c berries.
Cook stirring for 2 min or until boiling & thickened. (Makes about 1 cup)
Use - on pancakes, or on white cake etc.
raw_text:
Blueberry Sauce.
1/4 c sugar
1/4 c orange juice
2 tsp. cornstarch + 2 tbsp. water
1 c. blueberries
In sm. pan bring sugar & juice to boil, stirring to
dissolve the sugar. Blend cornstarch c 2 tbsp water.
stir into pan c berries. Cook stirring for 2 min or
until boiling & thickened. (Makes about 1 cup)
Use - on pancakes, or on white cake etc..
